articles.summary: Imagine watching Baywatch with the Hoff and his famous crew running down the beach toward the camera. Now imagine the same scene but without the equally famous piano, drums and vocals Baywatch soundtrack. It just isn't the same, right?Now imagine watching Back to the Future without its incredible soundtrack. It wouldn't make sense, or be as memorable, seeing Marty and the Doc on screen without it!Soundtracks matter.
articles.title: Premium Audio: Why Malibu Boats Have The Best Sound System on the Water
